name: select-box-group
description: A select box group is a set of select boxes from which the user chooses one or several options in a workflow.

documentBlocks.content: A select box group is a set of select boxes from which the user chooses one or several options in a workflow.

Keep select box groups to 9 items or less.

Select box groups work best with 3 to 9 items. If your experience needs more than 9 items, consider using a dropdown, checkboxes, or radio button group instead.

Use consistent sizing.

All select boxes in a group should be the same size to maintain visual consistency and usability.

orientation.description: The layout direction of the content in each select box.

anatomy.name: container
anatomy.description: Root of the group. It draws nothing itself: it holds the `items` part, which hosts the default slot.

anatomy.name: items
anatomy.description: Grid of select boxes. It draws nothing itself: it sets the gap between select boxes and wraps rows. It hosts the default slot.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The select boxes of the group. Any number, at least one.

anatomyReview.notes: Proposed, not yet confirmed by Design. Built from React Spectrum S2 SelectBoxGroup (orientation, selectionMode, isDisabled; children are SelectBox) and the swatch-group and checkbox-group precedent: a container root and one host part `items` for the default slot that accepts select-box. The Figma Web POC was not available, so the part names and the single-slot shape are unconfirmed. The select-box option multiple is left in place; selectionMode here is the group-level equivalent.
